scientific_limitations: Only d>=4 Euclidean regular cross-polytopes. The dimension-three special case was previously published; general mixed-norm sign pattern counts have precedent. Does not establish high-dimensional tilings or priority against unindexed historical results.
title: Orthogonal kernels of regular cross-polytopes in dimensions at least four
